Game Overview

In Funny Puppy Care, the core idea is straightforward: heal and nurture an adorable puppy back to health in Funny Puppy Care. Enjoy bathing, mending injuries, and playing mini-games, all while dressing up your furry friend in stylish outfits. Make every moment joyful and colorful as you maximize your score by keeping your pup happy and well-dressed.
